tools.name: quote
tools.description: Free: runs the same checks a paid call runs before payment (parameters, URL, DNS, public address, robots.txt, queue) without creating an invoice, and returns the price in sats and the accepted payment methods and Cashu mints.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screenshot, pdf · Private data: screenshot, pdf · Public sink: screenshot, pdf.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screenshot, pdf · Private data: screenshot, pdf · Public sink: screenshot, pdf

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
